newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine petrol hike to build roads not ruled out.
newsitem.headline: Argentine petrol hike to build roads not ruled out.

text.p: A proposed rise in petrol prices to finance the construction of highways would not be "traumatic," although the government would prefer to obtain the funds through a bond issue, Public Works Secretary Armando Guibert said.
"A rise of a cent per liter doesn't seem much," Giubert told the daily La Nacion.
But he said it "would be healthier" to issue a bond.
The government plans to build 10,000 km of national highways to link the country's major cities. It has estimated the investment at $10 billion and said 30,000 jobs would be created.
Authorities said earlier this week they were studying a $0.10 per liter fuel tax for petrol and diesel to finance the project.
